questions: Did your symptoms begin on one side of your body more than the other?
Do you have a tremor or shaking in your hands, especially when they are at rest?
Do you feel dizzy or lightheaded when you stand up?
Do you have urinary urgency, frequency, or incontinence?
Have you fallen more than once in the past year?
Do you have vivid, unpleasant dreams or act out your dreams while sleeping?
Do you have memory or thinking difficulties?
Do you see things that are not really there?
Are you currently taking any medications for psychiatric conditions, nausea, or vertigo?
Have you lost your sense of smell?
Has your handwriting become noticeably smaller?
Do you feel stiff or rigid in your muscles or limbs?
If you have been tried on a Parkinson's medication like carbidopa-levodopa (Sinemet), did it help your symptoms?
